cover_prompt: A vibrant, colorful children's book cover illustration for a baby animals coloring book. A collection of adorable kawaii baby animals gathered together in a cheerful meadow scene: a fluffy kitten with huge sparkling eyes, a chubby puppy wagging its tail, a baby bunny holding a carrot, a yellow duckling, and a baby panda. All animals have oversized heads, big round eyes, and rosy cheeks in kawaii style. Bright green grass, colorful wildflowers, a blue sky with fluffy white clouds, and a rainbow in the background. Professional children's book cover art style, bright eye-catching colors, extremely cute and inviting composition. DO NOT include any text, letters, or words in the generated image.
